requirements: OAuth 2.0 for Jira (and Freshworks account as needed)
Jira REST API: read/update issues for sync
Freshdesk and/or Freshservice ticket APIs for create/update/read
Configurable field and status mapping between Jira and Freshdesk/Freshservice during installation (iparams)
Scheduled events for periodic bidirectional or incremental sync
App webhooks or product webhooks where appropriate for near-real-time or event-triggered sync
Request templates (requests.json) for Jira and Freshdesk/Freshservice calls
OAuth config (oauth_config.json) aligned with Jira OAuth app settings
description: Serverless Freshdesk app that connects to Jira via OAuth 2.0 and keeps tickets in sync with Freshdesk or Freshservice, with Jira↔helpdesk field and workflow mapping defined by the installer in iparams (HTML/JS). Uses scheduled and/or webhook-driven runs so changes propagate between systems without manual copy-paste.
